description.text: DoctorAgent-RL is a novel reinforcement learning (RL)-based multi-agent collaborative framework that models medical consultations as a dynamic decision-making process under uncertainty. It addresses core challenges faced by LLMs in real-world clinical consultations, such as vague diagnoses from single-round systems and the inflexibility of traditional multi-turn dialogue models constrained by static supervised learning. In DoctorAgent-RL, a doctor agent continuously optimizes its questioning strategy within an RL framework through multi-turn interactions with a patient agent.

Please listen carefully to the patient's description, ask targeted questions, and collect sufficient information before giving a diagnosis and treatment recommendation.
serving.notes: The card's Python example sets model_name to Jarvis1111/DoctorAgent-RL, not this repository, and uses max_new_tokens=512 with the same temperature, top_k, and top_p. tokenizer_config.json inserts 'You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.' when no system message is passed. config.json max_position_embeddings is 32768; tokenizer model_max_length is 131072; the SFT script sets data.max_length=6784. config.json dtype is float32. There is no adapter_config.json. The SFT script then calls merge_and_unload into a local directory named DoctorLLM-7B-SFT-1000-thinking.

evaluation_reported.text: The card gives no numbers. arXiv HTML v2 Table 3 prints the SFT-only row (w/o RL) at average score 47.4 and 9.0 average turns, and DoctorAgent-RL at 53.9. HTML v3 states the SFT-only ablation is 6.5% lower than DoctorAgent-RL's average score of 53.9 and does not reprint 47.4. GitHub calls this repository the SFT model and Jarvis1111/DoctorAgent-RL the RL model, so 53.9 is the other checkpoint.

discrepancies: GitHub names this repository as the SFT model trained on MTMedDialog_sft_train, and names Jarvis1111/DoctorAgent-RL as the RL model, matching the inventory method, dataset, and parent. The card prose describes reinforcement learning, and its usage example loads Jarvis1111/DoctorAgent-RL. The paper's SFT table lists LoRA rank 8, batch size 64, learning rate 1e-4, and 3 epochs, with LLaMA-Factory. The script sft/finetune_lora_med.sh uses LoRA rank 64, alpha 32, and train batch size 128, with the same learning rate and 3 epochs. The paper does not print this repository id. The SFT parquet has 5,516 rows; the paper says the SFT stage used 1,000 dialogues.
